claim_scope: One operation added to the shipped obligation vocabulary, with an argument-shape condition, measured on two repositories. Detection only. No capability qualified.
question: Can the commonest collection read carry the access-control obligation without claiming every array search and jQuery selector?
why_it_was_missing: `find` was absent from a table holding findOne, findById, findAll and findByPk, so NodeGoat's documented insecure direct object reference raised no obligation at all: its module reads with allocationsCol.find(searchCriteria()). The name is shared with Array.prototype.find and jQuery's `.find`, so the name alone cannot carry an obligation.

discriminator.rule: the obligation is claimed only where the first argument has the shape of a query document

claimed.no arguments: col.find() reads the whole collection, the obligation at its widest
claimed.BLOCK: an object literal, which is how jssrc2cpg gives { owner: 1 }

not_claimed.METHOD_REF: a predicate passed to an array search, inline or a function expression
not_claimed.CALL that is an operator: a selector built at run time, <operator>.formatString or <operator>.addition
not_claimed.IDENTIFIER: deliberately not claimed. col.find(query) and arr.find(pred) are the same shape, and neither repository measured has one, so this is a stated false negative rather than an unmeasured risk.

discriminator.where_it_is_declared: query_document_arg on the operation fact; the arbiter that can see argument shapes decides it

census_after.note: Unchanged on both. Every new obligation is corroborated, and the corroborated band needs a judge the census does not configure.

limits: A query document passed as a bare variable is not claimed, which is a false negative this change chooses over an unmeasured false positive.
One jQuery repository measured. A bundle that calls find with an object literal for something other than a collection would be claimed.
The obligation being raised is not a finding: all seven NodeGoat verdicts are corroborated and none is reported without a judge.
NodeGoat and wp-statistics were both used to develop this analyser.
